artworks.title: At the Picton Bar, rue Scribe (Au bar Picton, rue Scribe)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on velin paper
artworks.description: The drawing shows three people seated at a bar. The central figure is a woman seen from the back, leaning slightly towards the bar. Her hair is up, and she wears a dress with puffed sleeves and a fitted bodice. She holds a glass at the bar. To her left, a man in profile wears a dark overcoat, top hat, and holds a cigar. To her right, another man with a bowler hat looks towards the woman. The background features a window with partially legible text, suggesting a bar or cafe setting.

artworks.title: Debauchery (Débauche)
artworks.medium: 4-color lithograph on velin paper
artworks.description: The image shows an illustration of two figures seated close together. The central figure is a woman with red curly hair and wearing a white dress. She sits with a relaxed posture, gazing away. The man behind her leans close, with short slicked-back hair and one arm around the woman. The background is muted red with text detailing "Catalogue d'Affiches artistiques A. Arnould 7 rue Racine Paris."

artworks.title: Poster for "Elles"
artworks.medium: lithograph in olive green, blue, and orange
artworks.description: The image shows a person from behind, revealing their entire body. The person is standing upright with their arms raised, holding their hair up. They have long red hair that they are styling or securing. The individual is wearing a long, dark blue dress with voluminous sleeves and a light-colored, fluffy collar. Around them, there is a sketched outline of a top hat and some bare outlines of furniture or drapery. The background is a light beige, featuring text in red and grayish tones about a lithography exhibition. The top left corner includes a small circular mark, and there is a faint stamp in the central upper region.

artworks.title: Frontispiece for "Elles"
artworks.medium: color lithograph on thin wove paper
artworks.description: The image is of a person standing with their back to the viewer, lifting their bright red-orange long hair with both hands. They are wearing a gown that has a deep blue lower half and a pale, ruffled top section in a lighter shade. Around the person are muted beige tones, sketch-like lines, and a top hat resting on a surface to the left. The background shows an abstract design with light brushstrokes and a faded pattern, creating a soft, vintage ambiance.

artworks.title: Soudais Deposition (Déposition Soudais)
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures wearing formal attire, engaged in a meeting. The figures are depicted with light pencil strokes on paper, wearing hats and formal garments. Some figures are focused on a document, while others are conversing or listening attentively. The composition emphasizes expressive gestural lines, capturing a moment of concentration and engagement. Background and details are minimally suggested.

artworks.title: Lebaudy Trial - Testimony of Mlle. Marsy (Procès Lebaudy - Déposition de Mlle. Marsy)
artworks.medium: lithograph in red
artworks.description: This image is a sketch showing the upper body of several figures. The central figure is a woman positioned in profile, slightly turned to the side. Her facial features are delicately sketched, lacking detailed refinement but suggest closed eyes and a serene expression. Her hair is drawn with a textured, voluminous quality, suggesting an upswept style. The woman is wearing a garment with a high collar and loose, flowing lines indicating the presence of clothing, perhaps a cape or coat. A stick or umbrella can be seen clasped in her hand. Surrounding her are faint, roughly sketched figures of people, wearing headgear or hats. The background is minimal, with a light cream color as the base of the sketch.

artworks.title: Program for "La lepreuse"  (Programme pour "La lépreuse")
artworks.medium: lithograph in red
artworks.description: The image depicts a person in profile view, with their head turned to the side. The individual is seated with hands clasped in front of their chest. The facial features are sketched minimally, and the person has medium-length, wavy hair. The clothing is depicted faintly, suggesting a long-sleeved garment with a structured fit. There are no visible jewelry or objects. In the background, there is text with details about a theatrical show called "Comédie-Parisienne," including the title "La Lépreuse" and a list of cast members. The image is drawn in a sepia tone, resembling pencil or charcoal on paper.

artworks.title: Cover for "La tribu d'Isodore" (Couverture pour "La tribu d'Isodore")
artworks.medium: lithograph in brown and yellow
artworks.description: The image depicts a man in a horse-drawn carriage. He is holding the reins with his left hand and his right hand is resting on his thigh. The man has a strong jawline, a prominent mustache, and is wearing a bowler hat, a suit, and a bow tie. A small terrier dog is beside him in the carriage. Above him are sketches of the same man with a top hat and of a different person's head and neck. The background is a plain flat surface.

artworks.title: New Year's Greeting (Le compliment du jour de l'an)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black
artworks.description: This is a drawing showing a seated figure and a standing figure with accompanying text. The image is done in a light, whimsical style. There are two figures interacting, one seated and one standing, with the standing figure holding an item out. Below them is a small seated figure drawn in a simple style. At the bottom is handwritten French text. The drawing is in pencil or a similar medium, creating a casual and light-hearted atmosphere.

artworks.title: Homage to Moliere (Hommage à Molière)
artworks.medium: lithograph in olive green and blue
artworks.description: The image is a theatrical performance pamphlet featuring a sketch of a group of figures. The sketch shows a dramatic scene with individuals engaged in various activities, alongside printed text describing two plays, "Le Bien D’Autrui" and "Hors Les Lois." The figures are depicted with simple pencil strokes, hinting at movement or conversation, and the styles of clothing suggest a historical or formal setting. The text includes cast lists, roles, and play names for an event at Théâtre Antoine during the 1897-1898 season.

artworks.title: Program for "Benefice Gemier" (Programme du "Bénéfice Gémier")
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on velin paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a man standing sideways, facing left. He is holding a piece of paper or canvas in one hand. The man is wearing a hat and a long overcoat that reaches his feet. He appears to be wearing boots. The background is an indistinct, textured surface.

artworks.title: At The House of Gold (A la maison d'or)
artworks.medium: lithograph in olive green
artworks.description: The image shows a pencil sketch with three individuals. The main figure is seated at a table, visible from the waist up, facing slightly to the right. This person is bald with minimal facial features drawn and is dressed in a tuxedo with a bow tie. On the table are items like bottles, a glass, and plates. Beside the sitting individual, another person stands with their body turned to the right, showing a side profile. This standing person is also bald and dressed formally. In the background, a third figure faces left, appearing to walk away from the table. This individual is also in formal attire. The background is plain, with minimalistic and incomplete lines suggesting a possibly interior setting, focusing on the central characters and table.

artworks.title: The First Vendor of Jourdan and Brown (Le premier vendeur de Jourdan et Brown)
artworks.medium: lithograph in olive green
artworks.description: The image depicts a sketch of two individuals shown from approximately mid-thigh up. The person on the left is seen from the back, standing with a slight forward lean, wearing a long coat and a bowler hat. The individual on the right is in profile, slightly hunched, and facing the other person. This person has a full beard and wears glasses. Their attire includes a jacket with a striped pattern and checkered trousers. A sign that reads "SHIRT" is partially visible in the background, along with indistinct sketch lines suggesting a street or shop setting.

artworks.title: Cover for "L'example de Ninon de Lenclos amoureuse"
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on paper
artworks.description:
The image is a pencil sketch divided into two sections, each depicting different figures. On the left side, there's a small drawing of a person walking a dog. The person, dressed in loose attire and wearing a turban or rounded hat, is walking alongside a fluffy, small dog.

On the right side, there are two larger figures depicted in a looser style. The figure in the foreground holds a fan in one hand and appears to have an elaborate hairstyle or headdress. The second figure behind them has their arms extending forward. The background is blank, focusing on the figures.

artworks.title: Bust of Mlle. Marcelle Lender, Turned Three Quarters (Mlle. Marcelle Lender en buste, de trois quartes)
artworks.medium: lithograph printed in red-brown on blue laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a sketch of a woman's upper body in a side profile. She has closed eyes, a slightly arched eyebrow, and subtle lips. Her hair is styled upwards with volume and is adorned with a large decorative element. She is wearing a high-neck garment with a necklace or collar that has round embellishments. The sketch has a textured, pale background with dark warm-tone lines and shading, giving it an unfinished quality.

artworks.title: Di Ti Fellow - Englishmen at the Cafe-Concert (Di Ti Fellow - Anglaise au Café-Concert)
artworks.medium: lithograph in brown on hand-made paper
artworks.description: This image shows a pencil sketch of three figures, featuring a woman standing upright with short hair and a detailed face, wearing a dress with puffed sleeves. To her right stands a man, partially obscured, and in the front sits a man holding a pipe. The background includes lightly sketched lines and draped fabric or curtains. An object resembling a hat is in the foreground on the left.

artworks.title: The Fine Printmaker Adolphe Albert (Le bon graveur - Adolphe Albert)
artworks.medium: lithograph on wove paper
artworks.description: There is a drawing of a man sitting at a table. His gaze is downward, focusing on a task. He has a short beard, mustache, and is wearing a suit jacket with lapels. The man wears a brimmed hat and has his hands on the table. There are papers, a book, or portfolio on the table. The background is textured.

artworks.title: The Jockey (Le Jockey)
artworks.medium: color lithograph on Chinese paper
artworks.description: This is a print showing two horses being ridden. The horses and riders have their backs to us. Two jockeys lean forward on their horses, both wearing tan pants. The one on the right has a light peach shirt and orange hair or an orange helmet, while the other has a white shirt with black hair or a black helmet. Both horses are a rich reddish-brown color, and their heads are extended forward with their hooves off the ground. The ground below them is pale green, and in the distance brown hills are visible, with a small windmill visible on the right. The sky above is light gray, with a few flags fluttering in the distance.

artworks.title: The Jockey (Le Jockey)
artworks.medium: color lithograph on Chinese paper [trial proof]
artworks.description: This is a painting of two jockeys riding horses on a racetrack. The painting depicts a dynamic scene from the perspective behind the horses and riders, showcasing the movement of the animals and the determined posture of the jockeys. The background shows a dirt racetrack with flags and a structure resembling a windmill in the distance. The color palette includes earthy tones that complement the natural setting. The composition emphasizes the energy of the race with loose brushwork and bold lines, reminiscent of the style of Henri de Toulouse-Lautrec.

artworks.title: The Jockey (Le Jockey)
artworks.medium: lithograph on Chinese paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of horses being ridden on a race track. It shows two horses in motion with riders leaning forward. The perspective is from behind, highlighting the musculature of the horses. The background includes poles or flags and a windmill. The sketch emphasizes the form and motion of the horses, conveying the intensity of a race.

artworks.title: The Small Pony from Calmese (Le petit poney de Calmèse)
artworks.medium: lithograph in dark brown on velin paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a horse and a small dog indoors. The sketch depicts a horse near a wall or barrier, with its head slightly lowered. There is a small dog in the lower left corner looking towards the horse. The background contains vertical and diagonal lines suggesting structures. The drawing appears to be done in pencil or charcoal on light-colored paper, with expressive lines capturing a casual moment between the two animals.

artworks.title: Promenade (Promenoir)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on Japan paper
artworks.description: The image is a sketch showing a group of people, with the upper part of their bodies depicted. In the foreground, a man on the right wears a coat with buttons and a flower pinned to his lapel, and he is donning a hat with a feather. He is standing with his hands partially in his pockets. Beside him, a woman with a feathered headpiece and a dress with a high collar and frilled details around the neck and shoulders stands slightly facing him. To their left, another man is shown in profile, wearing a top hat and holding what appears to be a stick or cane. Behind them, more individuals are faintly illustrated, wearing hats and gowns. The background shows an indistinct interior scene. The sketch is rendered in a loose, almost unfinished manner.

artworks.title: Mme. Le Marguoin, Milliner  (Mme. Le Marguoin, modiste)
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on velin paper
artworks.description: The image shows a portrait of a woman's upper body in profile. She is seated and looking to the right. Her facial features are delicately drawn, with a serene expression. She has an elaborate updo and is wearing a high-necked garment with a complex collar design. The background features a simple interior setting with a wall and a window ledge with stylized floral elements.

artworks.title: The Manor Lady or the Omen (La chatelaine ou le tocsin)
artworks.medium: lithograph in turquoise and light blue [poster]
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a dog and a pathway lined with trees.
